description: Backend, distributed systems, full-stack, and general software development roles.
commonMetricPlaceholders: scaled service to handle [Y] QPS / [N] concurrent requests
decreased AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure costs by $[Z]k/yr
improved automated test coverage from [A]% to [B]%
rejectionPitfalls: Listing technologies in skills block without any supporting bullet point evidence
Tutorial clone projects lacking custom architecture, unit tests, or live deployments
Vague responsibility verbs ('worked on', 'assisted with') lacking quantifiable ownership
Absence of metrics showing scale, latency, or business impact
hiringSignals: Demonstrated autonomous ownership of core subsystems end-to-end
Experience operating in on-call rotations and resolving production telemetry alerts
Authoring technical design documents (RFCs) and conducting rigorous code reviews
Active contributions to public open-source libraries or package registries
